# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Reviewed the pending amendment list against current HEAD, confirmed the API/core chemistry-semantics remediations were already present, and made the remaining TUI follow-up in `crates/tank_tui/src/screens/chemistry.rs` so the existing 7-ion scope/omission copy fits within the fixed-height derived panel by folding temperature into the DO line.

## Steps

0. [Completed] Compared the pending amendment list against the current `tank_api`, `tank_core`, and `tank_tui` state to identify what still required code changes versus what had already landed.
1. [Completed] Verified that the previously flagged API/core items were already satisfied in HEAD, including the biology sub-adult field, DIC legacy alias, DO semantics metadata, corrected TDS omission wording, and named/documented GH/KH/conductivity constants.
2. [Completed] Updated the chemistry TUI derived panel so the 7-ion proxy scope text remains visible without overflowing the fixed block height by combining the temperature readout with the DO line.
3. [Completed] Ran targeted validation for the chemistry semantics surfaces and recorded the remaining unrelated test/formatting issues outside this change.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo test -p tank_api` passed (3 tests), covering legacy chemistry aliases, estimate-scope metadata, and biology stage breakdown serialization.
- `cargo test -p tank_tui screens::tests::estimated_tds_scope_lines_name_included_and_omitted_species --lib` passed.
- `cargo check -p tank_tui` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_tui` failed only in the unrelated existing `screens::actions::tests::rejects_invalid_integer_counts` test.
- `cargo fmt --all --check` reported unrelated formatting drift in other modified files outside this change set.

## Outstanding Risks

- The worktree still contains unrelated pre-existing edits in `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs`, `crates/tank_core/tests/shrimp_population.rs`, `crates/tank_harness/src/lib.rs`, `crates/tank_tui/src/screens/biology.rs`, and `.ralph-burning/`; they were left untouched.
- `cargo test -p tank_tui` is still not fully green because the unrelated existing test `screens::actions::tests::rejects_invalid_integer_counts` fails in `crates/tank_tui/src/screens/actions.rs`.
- `cargo fmt --all --check` still reports unrelated pre-existing formatting drift in other dirty files, so I avoided a workspace-wide formatting rewrite and used targeted verification instead.
